steps.say: How to Use lists every screen of a project, and the links a reader gets when they press How to Use on it: a manual, a YouTube video, a recording, anything with an address.
The links hang off a project's screens. So first register the project, and scan it for its screens.
Once it is scanned, every screen is listed here. Search for one, add its links, and save. The How to Use button on that screen shows them at once.
